scope: Approved catalog and frontend-only implementation selection; provider account acceptance remains separate
evidence_boundary: Official auth docs, unauthenticated metadata/discovery reads and source comparison only. No DCR POST, consent, token exchange or business tool calls. Catalog-only is an implementation-scope assessment, not a live success claim.
